title: Machine learning systems need careful evaluation before deployment
summary: Production machine learning systems include much more than model code, including data collection, verification, monitoring, and serving.

title: Agents combine models, tools, and a control flow
summary: Agent systems can be organized as predefined workflows or as more autonomous agents that choose their own tool use.

title: Text to speech systems turn written input into audio
summary: Text-to-speech models generate speech audio from text and can differ in voice, language, and synthesis approach.
